EnvConfig.description:
Full episode/environment configuration (§6.6).

A named level (L1-L4, §6.7) is simply a frozen instance of this model,
loaded from configs/env/<Level>.yaml.
EnvConfig.title: EnvConfig

ReplayFrame.description: One step's delta (§27.2). `t` is the POST-step index (1-based).
ReplayFrame.title: ReplayFrame

team_share.description: β: fraction of positive reward shared
team_share.title: Team Share

SessionCreate.description:
Exactly one of `level` / `env_config`. `seed` generates the map when
it is procedural and ALWAYS seeds the policy's sampling stream, exactly
like `eval_seed` in the batch evaluator (§28.4).
SessionCreate.title: SessionCreate
